events.title: LiteLLM 1.108.1 signs images and backports LTS fixes
events.title_zh: LiteLLM 1.108.1 签名镜像并回移 LTS 修复
events.summary: LiteLLM 1.108 ships signed images and fixes credential-exposure paths. It expands MCP OAuth, session and toolset controls, adds streaming guardrails, and repairs budget accounting and admission behavior. The release is broad enough that production gateways should canary it instead of upgrading in place.
events.why_it_matters: For teams using LiteLLM as a shared model gateway, identity, budget and streamed-output enforcement sit on the request boundary. A regression there can leak credentials or bypass controls, so the security gains come with meaningful upgrade risk.
events.summary_zh: LiteLLM 1.108 提供签名镜像，并修复凭据暴露路径。该版扩展 MCP OAuth、会话和 toolset 控制，加入流式护栏，同时修复预算记账与准入行为。改动面较大，生产 gateway 应先做 canary，而不是原地升级。
events.summary_en: LiteLLM 1.108 ships signed images and fixes credential-exposure paths. It expands MCP OAuth, session and toolset controls, adds streaming guardrails, and repairs budget accounting and admission behavior. The release is broad enough that production gateways should canary it instead of upgrading in place.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对把 LiteLLM 用作共享模型 gateway 的团队来说，身份、预算和流式输出护栏都位于请求边界。这里的回归可能泄露凭据或绕过控制，因此安全收益伴随明显升级风险。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams using LiteLLM as a shared model gateway, identity, budget and streamed-output enforcement sit on the request boundary. A regression there can leak credentials or bypass controls, so the security gains come with meaningful upgrade risk.

technical_details.release: v1.102.0 stable; first stable PyPI artifact uploaded 2026-09-20T04:41:12.814548Z; Git tag commit 95293834e833b2d2979f87d1bd2a5be45db6728a
technical_details.agent_skills: serves registered skills through an Agent Skills well-known index and configures Claude Code or Codex with a gateway key
technical_details.mcp_controls: per-user MCP tool permissions apply to tools/list and tools/call; MCP OAuth and discovery handling improved; Conduct Guard integration added
technical_details.key_management: customer-managed KMS keys supported for virtual keys stored in AWS Secrets Manager
technical_details.observability: response headers expose the routed model, savings and complexity-routing decisions
technical_details.reliability: fixes cover spend double counting, Redis circuit-breaker state, streamed Bedrock spend buffering, secret redaction and fail-closed guardrail paths
technical_details.stabilization: backports fix request-parameter leakage, image/mask form handling, routing callback binding, streamed spend tracking, clean-snapshot fallback retries and team budget propagation
technical_details.update_2026_09_28: LiteLLM 1.103.0 stable (PyPI artifacts from 2026-09-27T17:47Z; GitHub release 2026-09-28T05:43Z): explicit Claude Code gateway endpoint, RFC 8693 IdP JWT token exchange, MCP client allowlists, live-session inspection and forced credential revocation, fail-closed upstream credentials, MCP-aware guardrails, Fuse v2 routing and budget/accounting fixes. The large RC aggregation requires production-shaped regression testing. Stays TRIAL.
technical_details.update_2026_10_05_litellm-1-104: 1.104.0 signs Docker images, rejects weak master keys, detects breached passwords, refreshes deactivated JWT user state, fixes MCP worker routing and stops unresendable spend-batch replay.
technical_details.update_2026_10_08: 1.104.2 stable backports `/v1/systemone`, the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` endpoint and the OpenAI Decisions provider from the development line.
technical_details.update_2026_10_11: 1.105.0 stable adds litellm.agent(), MCP capability/version discovery, stricter caller authorization, retrieved-chunk guardrails, private-destination blocking and routing/spend fixes.
technical_details.update_2026_10_18: 1.106.0 stable: stdio MCP disabled by default; MCP OAuth issuer binding and credential isolation; encrypted guardrail/search configuration; Anthropic and OpenAI workload identity; optional FIPS startup gate; signed containers; stronger spend backpressure and shutdown flush.
technical_details.update_2026_10_21: 1.107.0 stable: Microsoft 365 Copilot and per-user GitHub Copilot OAuth providers; hosted vLLM, Databricks and Azure Decisions routes; signed containers; failure-rate analytics; MCP bearer, Bedrock tool-call, spend and SDK 3 fixes.
technical_details.supply_chain_change: Container image signing key changed; old cosign verification policies will fail until updated. The eMudhra root CA was removed.
technical_details.update_2026_10_25: 1.106.4 fixes proxy startup failures when the remote model-cost map is unavailable and removes several container-scan false positives; fixes are backported to 1.104.7 and 1.105.5.
technical_details.release_2026_11_04: Signed images; credential leak fixes; MCP OAuth/session/toolsets; streaming guardrails; budget and admission repairs
technical_details.update_2026_11_05: Cosign-signed Docker images, stable/RC/LTS OSV scans, 21 mainline fixes plus prerequisites, and pass-through credential selection that skips team deployments.

evidence.claim_zh: LiteLLM 1.102.0 已进入 PyPI 稳定通道，保留 RC 中的 Agent Skills、Codex 与 Claude Code gateway 配置、按用户 MCP 权限、客户自管 KMS 和路由遥测。稳定化回移还修复了请求参数泄漏、流式费用统计、重试行为与团队预算继承。这个版本可以从只看 RC 的 POC 推进到受控的类生产试用。
evidence.claim_en: LiteLLM 1.102.0 has reached the stable PyPI channel with the Agent Skills, Codex and Claude Code gateway setup, per-user MCP permissions, customer-managed KMS and routing telemetry introduced in its release candidate. Stabilization backports also fix request-parameter leakage, streamed spend tracking, retry behavior and team budget propagation. The release is now suitable for a controlled production-like trial rather than an RC-only proof of concept.
